mechanism: Both risperidone and alcohol depress CNS function and impair dopamine/serotonin regulation, leading to additive sedation, cognitive impairment, and increased risk of orthostatic hypotension and motor dysfunction.
action: Advise patients to avoid alcohol consumption while taking risperidone due to risk of severe CNS depression, impaired judgment, and increased side effects; monitor for excessive sedation and orthostatic symptoms.
